messages:
Jordan (acct-ops): Hey team — since ~08:15 UTC our invoices API in structured JSON mode started returning invalid payloads. Our billing pipeline failed when parsing. Example of the response we got below.

maria-support: Sorry to hear that — can you paste the raw response and the request you used? Also which model/endpoint and any flags (json_mode, schema)?

Jordan (acct-ops): Reproable curl we used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer -H 'Authorization: Bearer *****' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"open-mpt-7b-v1","json_mode":"structured","prompt":"generate invoice JSON","schema":"invoice_schema_v2"}'
```
Response body we received (raw):
```json
{"invoice_id":"1234","amount":"1200","paid":null,"currency":"usd",}
```
Notes: amount used to be a number (1200) but now it's a quoted string, paid alternates between true/false/null, currency lowercased, and there's a trailing comma causing the client JSON parser to error. Billing job logs show: "SyntaxError: Unexpected token } in JSON at position 38".

alex-eng: We just repro'd hitting the same endpoint with json_mode=structured. Our SDK parser fails with the same trailing-comma error. Initial guess: model emitted an extra "," token and tokenization changed numbers into separate tokens which led to quoted numbers during generation.

anjali-ml: Quick context — there was a small tokenizer/quantization patch deployed to the open-mpt-7b family ~30m before these reports. Deploy bot shows:

deploy-bot: [deploy] 1769998000 - rolled open-mpt-7b-v1 tokenizer patch to subset of nodes (canary).

anjali-ml: Hypothesis: the tokenizer change altered how numeric sequences are split, and in combination with the schema-enforcing prompt, the model sometimes emits escapes/quotes around numeric tokens or appends a stray comma when it hits sequence boundaries. That explains both quoted numbers and trailing comma.

maria-support: Customer is on hosted API, model pinned to open-mpt-7b-v1. No account-level rollouts. Impact: their nightly reconciliation failed and invoices were delayed ~2 hours.

alex-eng: Short-term mitigations we can apply for this tenant: (1) gateway post-processing that strips trailing commas and coerces numeric-looking strings to numbers for fields declared numeric in the schema, (2) enforce currency normalization (currency.toUpperCase()), (3) treat null boolean as false if schema requires non-null boolean and downstream safe. We can also add a router rule to fallback to a stable variant if structured output fails validation.

anjali-ml: Agreed. For immediate triage I'll push a temporary policy: if structured output fails strict JSON parse, try a tolerant cleanup pass: remove trailing commas (regex), then run JSON.parse; after parsing, validate types and coerce where safe (numeric strings -> Number, lowercased enums -> uppercase). This is best-effort and will be tenant-scoped.

maria-support: Jordan — would you accept a tenant-scoped post-processing fix? We'll also add a fallback model rollout for any subsequent requests that fail validation.

Jordan (acct-ops): Yes please. I need invoices unblocked. Also would like a root-cause and long-term fix so this doesn't recur.

anjali-ml: Plan for permanent fix: (A) revert the tokenizer change from the canary nodes if evidence confirms correlation, (B) update our structured-output prompt templates to include explicit token-level constraints and emit termination tokens to avoid trailing punctuation, (C) add schema-gating in the runtime to detect and fallback before returning to customers. We'll open an eng-ml ticket and prioritize.

alex-eng: Action items (today): 1) Apply tenant-scoped post-process casts + tolerant parse (alex-eng). 2) Add router fallback rule to stable variant (alex-eng + eng-sre). 3) Eng-ML to investigate tokenizer canary and add prompt guard (anjali-ml). 4) Support to notify customer and document workaround (maria-support).

maria-support: Jordan — applying the tenant patch now and enabling fallback. I'll follow up when done and share logs.

Jordan (acct-ops): Thanks. Also FYI the billing job retries hit our rate limit so we had to stagger retries. Please let me know when the patch is live.

maria-support: Patch applied for tenant ID cu_93f. Enabling fallback to open-mpt-7b-v1-stable. Monitoring for 30m.

alex-eng: Verified the tolerant parse on a few sample responses from the customer — it unblocks the pipeline and coerces amount -> 1200 (Number), currency -> "USD". We'll keep the conversion rules strict to avoid data corruption (only convert if regex ^\d+$ or ^\d+\.\d+$).

anjali-ml: I'll open an internal postmortem and link to the tokenizer canary logs + the deploy that happened at 1769998000. If confirmed, we either fully revert the tokenizer change or tweak the prompt+generation config to avoid tokenization-sensitive outputs.

maria-support: Thanks everyone. Jordan — apologies again. We'll keep you posted and follow up with a permanent ETA in the PM. :thumbsup:

Jordan (acct-ops): Appreciate the quick triage.
